# watchpoint_escalation_policy (Resource)

An escalation policy walked when an alert stays unacknowledged. Each ordered step pages an on-call schedule, a specific user, or another alert profile after a delay.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_escalation_policy" "platform" {
  name             = "Platform Escalation"
  repeat_last_step = true
  max_repeats      = 3

  steps = [
    {
      target_type        = "OnCallSchedule"
      oncall_schedule_id = watchpoint_oncall_schedule.primary.id
      delay_minutes      = 0
    },
    {
      target_type       = "User"
      target_user_email = "lead@example.com"
      delay_minutes     = 10
    },
    {
      target_type             = "AlertProfile"
      notify_alert_profile_id = watchpoint_alert_profile.devops.id
      delay_minutes           = 20
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable policy name.
- `steps` (Attributes List) Ordered escalation steps. At least one step is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `max_repeats` (Number) Maximum number of times the final step is repeated. Defaults to `4`.
- `repeat_interval_minutes` (Number) Minutes between repeats of the final step when `repeat_last_step` is set. Defaults to `15`.
- `repeat_last_step` (Boolean) Keep re-paging the final step until the alert is acknowledged. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Escalation policy ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Required:

- `target_type` (String) Step target. One of `OnCallSchedule`, `User`, `AlertProfile`.

Optional:

- `delay_minutes` (Number) Minutes to wait before this step fires. Defaults to `0` (immediate).
- `notify_alert_profile_id` (String) Alert profile to fan out to (required when `target_type` is `AlertProfile`).
- `oncall_schedule_id` (String) On-call schedule to page (required when `target_type` is `OnCallSchedule`).
- `step_order` (Number) Order the step runs in (ascending). Server-assigned when omitted.
- `target_user_email` (String) User email to page (used when `target_type` is `User`).
- `target_user_id` (String) User ID to page (used when `target_type` is `User`).
- `target_user_name` (String) Display name for the paged user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_escalation_policy.platform esp_001
```
